Bill.BriefDescription: Providing parity for home care agency workers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to parity for home care agency workers; and addingnew sections to chapter 74.39A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.39A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall create a formula that converts the cost of theincrease in wages and benefits negotiated every two years in thecontract for individual provider home care workers into a perhouramount. That perhour amount shall be added to the home care agencyvendor rate and must be used exclusively for improving the wages andbenefits of home care agency workers. The formula must account for alltypes of wages, benefits, and compensation negotiated each biennium,including but not limited to: (1) Regular wages; (2) Benefit pay, such as vacation, sick, and holiday pay; (3) Taxes on wages/benefit pay; (4) Mileage; (5) Labor costs required for home care agencies but not for p. 1 SB 6145individual provider home care agency workers, such as travel pay,administrative pay, overtime, and overprovided hours; and (6) The average cost of workers' compensation for home careagencies.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.39A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Benefits, including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision,shall be provided to home care agency workers at the same rate and onthe same basis as benefits negotiated for individual provider home careworkers.
